# Step 2.128: the independent review (2026-11-25)

Reviewer: not a builder of this step. Code unchanged; the probes were temporary test files, deleted afterwards.

## High

- **H1 A code for one account's change of email is spent from another account and moves the first (Supabase adapter).** `packages/providers/src/sign-in/supabase/supabase-sign-in.ts:789` verifies the code with Supabase before checking whose it is (line 809). Supabase finds the user by pending address and code, not by session, so the move has already happened.
  - Probe: A and B both start a change to x@, and B types A's code. B is told `code-wrong`, but A's sign-in address is now x@. Our `accounts.email` for A is unchanged, A's other devices stay signed in, and A's old address gets no "changed" notice.
  - Takeover: a victim types the attacker's address by mistake and never types the code. The attacker starts a change to the same address from any account of theirs, spends the victim's code, then resets the victim's password through x@.
  - The stand-in is safe (it keeps codes per account). Fix: keep a hash of each account's own code in our store under (account, address), and call Supabase's verify only when it matches.

## Medium

- **M1 The code answer tells whether an address has an account (T-68, T-457).** When Supabase refuses with `email_exists` (line 733), no pending address is kept on the user, so confirm answers `code-expired` at once (line 765). A free address answers `code-wrong`. Probe: taken gives `code-expired`, free gives `code-wrong`. The builder's test hides this because it starts a second, free change before confirming.
- **M2 "Asking again replaces the pending change" is false on Supabase (T-455).** Probe: start y@, then start a taken address, then type y@'s code. It succeeds and moves the account to y@, the address the person had replaced.
- **M3 A scorer with no name, mid-game, is told the wrong thing.** The gate's 403 `account-problem` (`apps/web/src/server/league-api.ts:81`) is read by the tracker as `not-allowed` (`apps/web/src/features/tracker/tracker-controller.ts:529`), so the screen says: "You are no longer allowed to score this game… if an admin gives the game back to you". The taps are kept, but nothing tells the scorer to give their name.
  - The gate runs on every request, not only at sign-in (`apps/web/src/server/database-ports.ts:261`). Once this lands, every account made before this step is cut off at its next request, the test copy's seed members included.
  - So this step must not be deployed during a game, and the tracker needs its own reason and text for a missing name.

## Low

- L1 The email and password forms run before the name gate. `email-actions.ts:51` uses `ownName.accountOf`, and the password action calls the service directly. A nameless account can change its own email and password with a hand-written post. This reaches only its own account, never league data (found by reading the code).
- L2 A pending change of email survives a password change made in the same session. Probe: start a change, change the password, type the code: the email changes. Every other device is signed out, so only the owner's own session can do this (`local-sign-in.ts:509` keeps `emailChanges`; Supabase behaves the same).
- L3 The name screen offers "Sign out" but not "Sign out everywhere", so a nameless person who has lost a device must give a name first (`account/page.tsx`, NameScreen).
- L4 `unreleased-screen.tsx:28` and `account/confirm/page.tsx:26` send the person to `/account` without `next` (S-125), so they land on their account page instead of where they were going.
- L5 Two name submissions at once: `create_own_profile` checks and then inserts, so the second hits the unique index `profile_access_one_self_per_account` (migration 0003). It fails as a server error, not `alreadyNamed` (found by reading, not run).

## Sound (proved)

- `next` (S-125): `safeReturnPath` refuses these values:
  - other sites: `//host`, `/\host`, `\\host`, a full address;
  - other schemes: `javascript:`;
  - encoded tricks: `/%2F%2F`, `/%5C`, `/a/..//host`, `/%2e%2e//`, a tab, CRLF.

  I probed 15 values. It accepts any path of ours, for example `/north-valley/admin`, which still passes the league gate.

- The gate: every page, invitation, league API route and live-listen reaches `ports.identify` (checked with grep). The legal pages are not gated.
- Migration 0031: both functions are `security definer` with `search_path` set, pinned in app-role and isolation, and act only for the account the session sets.
- A sign-up's code cannot be spent as an email change, nor the other way round.
- The password change takes `context` from the cookie; the form carries no account id. Wrong old passwords count with sign-in guesses (T-225, per address, as before).
- Browser tests: your-name-test (17 checks), change-password-test (10) and change-email-test (14) passed in 29 s.
- Break by hand: I removed `refresh()` in `email-actions.ts`, and change-email-test failed on "Signed in as". Put back, rebuilt, passed again.
- The forms' words come from message files.
- Not verified: a tracker session mid-game through a password change, in a browser.
